record.question: Which organ is most radiosensitive in adults?
record.explanation: Answer C: Bone marrow. Bone marrow is highly radiosensitive because it contains rapidly dividing hematopoietic cells. Reference: https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle; https://aerb.gov.in/images/PDF/DiagnosticRadiology/REGULATORY-REQUIREMENTS-FOR-DIAGNOSTIC-RADIOLOGY-PRACTICE.pdf; https://nucleus.iaea.org/sites/nss-oui/Published%20Chunks/m_60b8e698-4f59-4c24-809a-dfb819ac5050/c_92a88144-44da-418c-a878-9c778590e687__9_0.Html.
